name: Margaret Wren, ASLA
title: Principal Landscape Architect
bio: Margaret founded Stonehaven in 2011 after eight years at Reed Hilderbrand. Her work has been recognized by the American Society of Landscape Architects and published in House & Garden and Garden Design. She holds an MLA from the Harvard Graduate School of Design.
credentials: ASLA, registered in NY, CT, NJ, MA
MLA, Harvard Graduate School of Design
BFA, Rhode Island School of Design

name: Daniel Harlowe
title: Master Mason · Build Director
bio: Daniel runs Stonehaven's build operations and is a third-generation mason. His crews build every wall, terrace, and water feature in-house. He has trained twelve apprentices in dry-stone construction since 2015 and serves on the New York Stone Industry Alliance.
credentials: NY State licensed home improvement contractor
